content.short: GeckoTerminal is a DEX data tracker and price charting tool by CoinGecko.
content.description: GeckoTerminal provides real-time statistics and price analysis across multiple blockchains and decentralized exchanges, consolidating market data into a single view. Users can identify trends as they emerge and access up-to-date statistics on tokens and pools across diverse networks. The platform also presents Proof of Reserves data, enabling users to monitor centralized exchanges' on-chain holdings and assess reserve transparency directly on the blockchain.
